# Tags - The tag is not displayed after being updated when the product is disabled

The tag is not diplayed after being updated when the product is disabled

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/89604350/164194691-8e0d9d9c-763a-4ea6-9b85-5d4aa8823c6c.mp4


Thanks to @HanaRebaiQA.

## Étapes
1. Create a product V2
2. In the SEO tab > add a new tag with a specified language (eg: English)
3. Disable this product and save
4. Go to BO > Shop parameters > Search > Tags page
5. Edit the last tag created
6. Change in another languages (eg: Frensh) and Save
7. Come back to the product
8. Check the tag with the updated language
9. See error >> the tag is not displayed
